title: SPeaR: Test-Time Adaptation with Steering Primitives for Realigning Representations
abstract: arXiv:2609.24111v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses distribution shift using only unlabeled test data. Existing methods typically adapt pretrained models by updating their parameters, limiting both what is adapted and where adaptation can occur within the network. We instead keep the pretrained network frozen and steer its intermediate representations. We introduce SPeaR (Steering Primitive for Realigning Representations), which inserts lightweight learnable modules at stage boundaries and optimizes them directly from the test stream, requiring neither source data nor supervised warm-up. Each primitive is optimized using a gated objective that reduces uncertainty only when adaptation is beneficial, along with a diversity regularizer to prevent collapse, and a multi-depth anchor to stabilize adaptation. translated_title: SPeaR：基于转向原语的测试时适应方法用于重新对齐表示
translated_abstract: 测试时适应（TTA）仅使用无标签的测试数据来应对分布偏移问题。现有方法通常通过更新预训练模型的参数来进行适应，这既限制了可适应的内容，也限制了适应在网络中可以发生的位置。我们反其道而行之，保持预训练网络冻结，转而引导（steer）其中间表示。我们提出了SPeaR（用于重新对齐表示的转向原语），它在网络阶段边界处插入轻量级可学习模块，并直接从测试数据流中对其进行优化，既不需要源数据，也不需要监督式预热。每个原语通过一个门控目标函数进行优化，该目标函数仅在适应有益时才降低不确定性，同时配合多样性正则化器以防止表示坍缩，并采用多深度锚点来稳定适应过程。我们证明了引导早期表示是最有效的策略，并且相同的原语可以在卷积网络和Transformer架构之间迁移。
tldr: SPeaR通过在冻结的预训练网络阶段边界插入轻量级可学习的“转向原语”模块，并直接从无标签测试流中优化这些模块以重新对齐中间表示，无需源数据或监督预热即可实现有效的测试时适应。
en_tdlr: SPeaR inserts lightweight learnable steering primitives at stage boundaries of a frozen pretrained network and optimizes them directly from the unlabeled test stream to realign intermediate representations, enabling effective test-time adaptation without requiring source data or supervised warm-up.
